title: Kubernetes' Lineage from Google's Borg
explainer: Kubernetes was designed by engineers who had built and operated Borg, Google's internal cluster manager, and its successor Omega, for roughly a decade before Kubernetes' 2014 open-source release. Core Kubernetes ideas - declarative desired-state objects, pods, and controller-based reconciliation - trace directly to lessons learned running Borg at Google's scale. Knowing this lineage explains why Kubernetes favors a declarative, self-healing model over an imperative, script-driven one.
